C.title: C. Reading Comprehension
intro: Daniel works for a small computer company in Cairo. He is a sales assistant, and he usually starts work at nine o’clock. He speaks to customers, answers e-mails, and sometimes visits other companies. Daniel likes his job because he meets many different people.

Last Thursday was very busy. Daniel had a meeting in the morning and visited a customer after lunch. He left the office at 5:30. In the evening, he met his sister at a restaurant. They had dinner and talked about their plans for the weekend.

This weekend, Daniel is going to Alexandria with two friends. They are leaving on Friday morning by car. Daniel wants to swim and relax, but one of his friends wants to visit museums. They are coming back on Sunday evening.
questions: 1. Where does Daniel work?
2. What does he do at work? Give two examples.
3. Why does Daniel like his job?
4. What did Daniel do last Thursday morning?
5. Where did he go in the evening?
6. Who is Daniel going to Alexandria with?
7. When are they leaving?
8. What does Daniel want to do there?
9. When are they coming back?
10. Write one sentence from the passage that talks about the past.

D.title: D. Listening & Summary
intro:
Your teacher will read a short passage aloud. Listen carefully. Do not write while the teacher is reading the first time. Then write a short summary in your own words.

Your summary should include the main person, place, important events, and plans.

E.title: E. Writing Task
intro: Write a short paragraph about yourself and your life. Include information about:

• your name and where you are from
• your work or studies and what you usually do
• something you did last weekend
• something you are doing or planning for next weekend
• one activity you can do well
Use complete sentences and connect your ideas.
